problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute a fixed budget across 17 neighborhood development projects to maximize the overall community benefit score.  
The profile for each project is as follows:  
* Project A: benefit score 0.022, impact factor 0.185, allocation limits [0.049, 0.341]  
* Project B: benefit score 0.166, impact factor 0.186, allocation limits [0.019, 0.873]  
* Project C: benefit score 0.170, impact factor 0.261, allocation limits [0.007, 0.819]  
* Project D: benefit score 0.081, impact factor 0.294, allocation limits [0.096, 0.378]  
* Project E: benefit score 0.095, impact factor 0.069, allocation limits [0.028, 0.423]  
* Project F: benefit score 0.143, impact factor 0.123, allocation limits [0.023, 0.559]  
* Project G: benefit score 0.093, impact factor 0.165, allocation limits [0.066, 0.726]  
* Project H: benefit score 0.160, impact factor 0.065, allocation limits [0.007, 0.585]  
* Project I: benefit score 0.117, impact factor 0.042, allocation limits [0.006, 0.662]  
* Project J: benefit score 0.079, impact factor 0.175, allocation limits [0.052, 0.863]  
* Project K: benefit score 0.024, impact factor 0.141, allocation limits [0.017, 0.652]  
* Project L: benefit score 0.161, impact factor 0.269, allocation limits [0.086, 0.601]  
* Project M: benefit score 0.186, impact factor 0.037, allocation limits [0.041, 0.711]  
* Project N: benefit score 0.048, impact factor 0.040, allocation limits [0.016, 0.465]  
* Project O: benefit score 0.191, impact factor 0.170, allocation limits [0.011, 0.304]  
* Project P: benefit score 0.079, impact factor 0.019, allocation limits [0.054, 0.386]  
* Project Q: benefit score 0.133, impact factor 0.210, allocation limits [0.048, 0.338]  

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified limits, and the sum of all budget shares must equal the total available budget (normalized to 1).  
To ensure timely completion, the set of quick-delivery projects Q = {B, C, F, G, H, J, K, N} must together receive at least 0.357 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the overall impact factor of the portfolio must not exceed 0.184, and the total benefit score must be at least 0.103.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
